project.name: zapi-cli
project.description: Standalone cross-platform CLI binary providing a scriptable interface to any Zoho product's REST APIs. Primary consumer is AI agents (GitHub Copilot CLI Skills, Claude Agent Skills). Manages multiple Zoho accounts via OAuth Self-Client authentication and exposes a general-purpose HTTP API invoker where the caller supplies the full URL at invocation time.

projects.name: ZapiCli
projects.responsibility: Entry point. Spectre.Console command wiring, Program.cs, DI registration. No business logic.

projects.name: ZapiCli.Core
projects.responsibility: All domain logic: AccountStore, OAuthProvider, ApiClient, TraceWriter, TraceSession, TraceExporter, ApiRegistry. No Spectre.Console dependency.

projects.name: ZapiCli.Keychain
projects.responsibility: IKeychainProvider interface + OS platform implementations + AES-256-GCM fallback. No dependency on Core or ZapiCli.

projects.name: ZapiCli.Tests
projects.responsibility: xUnit unit tests for ZapiCli.Core and ZapiCli.Keychain using in-memory fakes. No real OS keychain or network access.

techStack.keychain: Direct P/Invoke to OS APIs — NO third-party NuGet keychain package

authModel.v1: Mobile OAuth 2.0 — CLI generates RSA key pair, opens /oauth/v2/mobile/auth in browser, Zoho encrypts client_secret in redirect callback (gt_sec). DC auto-detected from callback location parameter. Credentials stored as camelCase JSON blob in OS keychain under key 'zapi-cli:<accountName>:oauth'. Auto-refresh via stored clientId + clientSecret + refreshToken on 401.

v1: IKeychainProvider + all platform implementations + AES-256-GCM fallback
AccountStore + AccountEntry with Dc + Zuid + Email + Scopes fields
account command group (login, list, show, set-default, use, remove, refresh, rename)
ApiClient with host allowlist + ZohoCorp block
api request command (--url required, full URL every invocation)
v2: Trace system (TraceWriter, TraceSession, TraceExporter, trace session commands)
mobileOAuth: account login command — Mobile OAuth 2.0 flow with RSA key exchange (Stories 10-12)
LocalCallbackServer — ephemeral-port HTTP listener for OAuth callback
IOAuthBrowserFlow / OAuthBrowserFlow — authorization URL builder + system browser launcher
IRsaKeyPairProvider / RsaKeyPairProvider — RSA 2048-bit key pair generation for gt_sec decryption
MobileCallbackResult — parsed redirect callback parameters (code, state, gt_sec, gt_hash, accounts_server, location)
DcResolver — maps Zoho location parameter to DC short name

outputContract.principle: No success wrapper envelope. All successful output to stdout is plain JSON — no { status, data } wrappers.

stdoutByCommand.apiCall_success: Raw Zoho API response body, byte-for-byte as received
stdoutByCommand.apiCall_httpError: Raw Zoho response body on stdout; API_ERROR envelope on stderr; exit 1
stdoutByCommand.accountList: JSON array of account objects (token masked)
stdoutByCommand.accountShow: JSON object for the account (token masked as ***)

outputContract.note: OQ-001 flags a contradiction: output contract table says account add returns raw Zoho user-info body, but the account add flow step 10 says { status, data }. Resolve at Story 4 implementation time.
